execution_ref_policy: Resolve the immutable execution commit from GITHUB_SHA and record it in the artifact.

one_changed_factor.name: entropy_cost
one_changed_factor.rationale: The pinned official SILG launch.py defines both 0.05 and 0.005 for RTFM. Immutable run 30203026269 evaluated 0.05 and failed with zero correct success while random achieved 4/60. Test the remaining official value without changing architecture, sources, data, seeds, split, frame request, actor count, batch size, unroll length, or matched evaluation instances.

required_artifacts: three checkpoints with actual frame count, bytes and SHA-256
per-seed peak RSS and training wall time
policy entropy and episode termination statistics
pre-mask and post-mask logits plus invalid-action probability mass
raw install, training, evaluation and qualification logs
qualification: correct win rate greater than random
three-seed mean improves and minimum seed does not regress
failure_policy: If entropy_cost=0.005 also fails, retain initial_reproduction_failure, reject entropy_cost as the sole cause, and proceed to exactly one next diagnosed factor in this order: official evaluation/default parity; recurrent reset/detach and optimizer/checkpoint restore; learning rate/gradient clipping/unroll. Do not create a new mechanism family, toy hypothesis, branch, or PR chain.
